admission.justification: An unowned database operation escaping the guard would silently reopen the retired canonical store.

applicability: The database retirement guard's event attribution.
conditions: The guard observes APSW and file operations during tests.
exclusions: The standard-library connections coverage itself makes; those are the named exception.
statement: A database event with no repository frame is refused under its own name except for the standard-library connections coverage creates.
